finalSeries.note: The final tied 2-2 on Apr 22, so it went to a best-of-7 of category matchups, three songs a game.

cats: Kate Bush - Why Should I Love You?
The Desert Sessions - Bring it Back Gentle
D'Angelo - She's Always in My Hair
Elliott Smith & Mary Lou Lord - Birthday Boy

years.note: Beastie Boys won the final 3-1 on the playlists (game 1), then Jimi Hendrix won the best-of-7 series 4-2. After this year, the series is only a tiebreaker for a 2-2 final.
